semiconductor_relevance: Medium — CHELPIS Quantum Corporation focuses on quantum-safe technologies and cryptography, which are relevant to semiconductor security but not directly involved in traditional semiconductor manufacturing or design.
summary: CHELPIS Quantum Corporation specializes in Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) technology, providing quantum-safe solutions for data security across various sectors including government and finance. Their offerings include Quantum-Safe AI Data Centers and hardware security technologies that integrate quantum-resistant defenses into silicon wafers.

regional_presence.Taiwan: CHELPIS is headquartered in Taiwan and is actively involved in the NIST PQC standardization process.
